mapper.sql: SELECT cs.course_site_id, cs.course_id, cs.site_id, cs.position, cs.verse_no, COALESCE(i18n.name, ko.name, s.name) AS site_name, s.status AS site_status, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.verify_radius, s.qr_version, s.qr_location_hint FROM course_site cs JOIN site s ON s.site_id = cs.site_id LEFT JOIN site_i18n i18n ON i18n.site_id = s.site_id AND i18n.locale = #{locale} LEFT JOIN site_i18n ko ON ko.site_id = s.site_id AND ko.locale = 'ko'
mapper.select: SELECT cs.course_site_id, cs.course_id, cs.site_id, cs.position, cs.verse_no, COALESCE(ko.name, s.name) AS site_name, s.status AS site_status, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.verify_radius, s.qr_version, s.qr_location_hint FROM course_site cs JOIN site s ON s.site_id = cs.site_id LEFT JOIN site_i18n ko ON ko.site_id = s.site_id AND ko.locale = 'ko' WHERE cs.site_id = #{siteId}

SELECT cs.course_site_id, cs.course_id, cs.site_id, cs.position, cs.verse_no, COALESCE(ko.name, s.name) AS site_name, s.status AS site_status, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.verify_radius, s.qr_version, s.qr_location_hint FROM course_site cs JOIN site s ON s.site_id = cs.site_id LEFT JOIN site_i18n ko ON ko.site_id = s.site_id AND ko.locale = 'ko' WHERE cs.course_site_id = #{courseSiteId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_site WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_site cs JOIN course c ON c.course_id = cs.course_id WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
